Dear Sirs,

ON LINE Single Tenders Enquiry (STE) are invited from M/s. Avery India Limited throug h above portal from in Single Packet Bid system for supply of following materials at our Indian C opper Complex Unit, Post – Moubhandar, Sub-Division-Ghatsila, Dist. East Singhbhum, Jharkhand 8 32103:- Sr. N Material Co Material Description Unit Qty. o. de Design, Supply, Erection, Testing, & Commissio ning of Pitless 60 Ton Road Weigh Bridge, platf 1 011490345 orm size 12.12 Mtrs X 3 Mtrs, Resolution 10 Kg. Number 1 Make – Avery as per enclosed bills of quantity a nd terms & conditions Annexure – I (Technical Details & Scope of Work) Technical Details & Scope of Work: A. Bidder Scope of Supply 1 Complete supply of Weigh Bridge Model No. ZM510-J2 with Analog Load Cells T302X. Platfo rm size= 12.12 mtr.x3 mtr. Resolution 10 Kg suitable for 60T weighing capacity as per S.N o.1 of BOQ, Pitless type Adhering to IS:800 standards and the use of Finite element analysi s (FEA) for validation ensuring compliance and robust performance even in challenging en vironments. 2 Supply of all drawings, technical specifications, catalogue of the weigh bridge, load cell etc. 3 All the civil work for foundation & installation of weigh bridge with 5.5 mtr. ramp at both si des as per sl. No. 6a of BOQ. 4 All the civil work for installation of Porta cabin and earth pit as per sl.No. 6 b&c of BOQ. 5 Supply and installation of accessories inside porta cabin as mentioned in BOQ. All electrica l wiring, installation of lights, A/C, switches inside porta cabin etc. 6 Analog Load Cells Model T302X 6.1 Rated Capacity of Load Cell: 45 T for each Load Cell. 6.2 Make of Load Cells & Design: Hermetically sealed IP 69K against moisture & corrosiv e elements to keep load cells unaffected even in harshest environmental conditions 6.3 Mounting kits for the entire above load cells with pad plate. 6.4 Accuracy Class: Minimum C5 or better 6.5 Safe overload capacity: 150% of rated capacity or better 6.6 Ultimate load capacity: 200% of rated capacity or better 6.7 Protection Class: IP-68 & IP-69K. IP68- Immersion of Water column of 1.5mtr for 10,000 hours IP69K- Water under high pressure & Steam Cleaning Extremely rugged and high oper ational efficiency with durability for many years 6.8 Load cell Integral cable core: Robust, flexible, screened, sheath: TPE, 6.9 Insulation Resistance: >5000 x 106 Ω at 100V DC 6.10 Protection from Lighting, over voltage Protection & stray welding current: In Built 6.11 Vibration Resistance: 20 g, 100 h, 10 ... 150 Hz 6.12 Supply Voltage: Max. 32 V; Nominal Deflection: 0.3 mm. 6.13 Permissible Eccentricity: 10 mm. 6.14 Load cell calibration and testing certificate must be provided along with supply. 6.15 Load cells shall be installed in conjunction with special mounts to ensure self-centerin g effect, protection from damage & correct weighing even if structure is in inclined p osition.

7 Jumbo Display: Minimum 100 mm, bigger size LED display for drivers - 01 nos. for weighbri dge, for display to drivers.RT 8 Junction Box and Cables 8.1 Drip and dust proof sealed Junction Box for above load cells in best suited housing (p rotection IP 65 or better) – 01 nos. for Weigh Bridge , with cornering compensation fa cilities, with double compression cable glands 8.2 Standard fault diagnostics, Unit of measure - Kg, Real time clock- battery backup, St andard ports, no motion detection 8.3 IP Rating - IP 69K rated- stainless steel housing, 8.4 Mounting – Preferably desk, tabletop Wall mounting can also be considered 8.5 Calibration- Software calibration, Full digital five-point calibration 8.6 High Speed conversion with response time from 5 ms 8.7 Inbuilt Serial Interface RS 232 / RS 485/ USB ports for Printer 8.8 3nos. DI/DO inbuilt for Limit function (Optional) 8.9 Display – 6-digit 7 segment, Trans reflective LCD display, back lighted, better visibilit y in day light and night. 8.10 Operating Keys: Minimum Keys shall be as Setup, Tare, Set, Reset, Gross, Zero, Print, Test 8.11 Accuracy 6000 d according to OIML R76 Class III 8.12 Equipped with Surge suppressor and lightening protection 8.13 Digitizer (Indicating controller) itself must have Password (Numeric/Alphanumeric) pro tection facility, so as to protect the system from tampering/manipulation). 9 Cornering Box (Field JB)with Lock and Key facility 10 Software for Weigh Ticket Prints Outs 10.1 Licensed Software for weigh bridge (with license dongle if required) 10.2 Windows based software to communicate with weighing indicator & for weigh ticket printout which will have following minimum information: Name of Company Address of Company Date Truck no. Material Gross Weight Tare weight Net weight Customer/Party Name etc. Shift wise/Date wise report Customer wise/Material Wise Report 11 Installation and maintenance manual Installation and maintenance manual in the form of hard copies along with soft copy to be provided. All relevant documentation of hardware, software, wiring details, layout, drawing s, and technical literature of hardware supplied, indenting specifications/part nos. of spare s etc. to be provided by supplier. The document should also include information required fo r operation, programming, calibration, maintenance and troubleshooting. 12 Complete set of tools & tackles Complete set of tools & tackles required for erection and commissioning should be provide d by the supplier. Any special Tools and tackles if required for afterwards maintenance sho uld be provided with standard delivery- Min. 04 Sets. 13 Calibration of the Platform with 1/10th of maximum capacity i.e. 6 Ton Weight or more up t o 60 Ton has to be done and shown to HCL Engineer in charge at the time of commissionin g.

14 Submission of the Invoice of the new weight procurement against the particular Weigh Brid ge for stamping to Weights & Measures, verification and Stamping from Weight & Measure dept. 15 Integration of the weigh Bridge with ERP System—Party has to integrate the new weigh bri dge with our ERP system for which LAN connection will be provided by HCL at the Porta Ca bin. Necessary license for this will be provided to the Party. 16 Training at Site to M/s HCL Manpower (operators, engineers etc.) The engineer should conti nue for minimum of 2 days with the operator for training purpose. 17 Guarantee/Warranty Clause: - Party shall provide full guarantee of the supplied Road We igh Bridge (Complete Set) for a period of 12 months from the date of installation or 18 mon ths from the date of supply whichever is earlier. B. HCL/ICC Scope of Supply: 1. 220 V +/- 10 %, 50Hz, Single Phase Power Supply upto Porta cabin. LAN connection at Port a cabin. 2. Arrangement of Crane for unloading of material at site and keeping them at a safe place. 3. Arrangement of necessary standard weight as per Weight & Measures Rules at site during calibration, Standard test weights shall be provided by M/s HCL at the time of calibration, 4. After commissioning, HCL will arrange to provide necessary Govt. stamping fees in the for m of DD for submission at the office of Deptt. of Legal Metrology. However, it is the respon sibility of the Party to arrange to issue stamping certificate. 5. Accommodation -- Accommodation may be provided to Supervisors/Engineers during worki ng period at Co's Guest House on chargeable basis subject to availability. 6. Delivery as well as completion Schedule of contract – 120 days from the date of placement of the order. 7. Payment Schedule – 30 days credit and as per below schedule: a. 60% of the supplied items as per sl No. 1 to 5 of BOQ will be released after delivery & inspection of materials at Surda Mines site. Rest 40% will be released after final com missioning, testing & stamping along with Sl. No.7 of BOQ. b. For all civil works as per sl. No.6 of BOQ payment will be released on pro-rata basis af ter satisfactory completion of each job. c. Party is requested to provide break up of total cost as per enclosed Bill of quantity in order to facilitate payment process as per Annexure - IV. Important Note: (1) Only Payment term 30 days credit, as per payment schedule. (2) Delivery Period: Immediately but within 120 days from the date of receipt of PO. (3) Inspection of materials at our stores will be final. (4) Offer must be submitted FOR destination, delivery of materials at our Mosabani Mines Store, Mosabani basis. Supplier shall arrange transporter and deliver materials as freight paid basis . (5) Delivery Address: Store-in-Charge, Hindustan Copper Limited, Indian Copper Complex, Mo saboni Mines Stores, Post: Mosaboni, Distt. East Singhbhum, Jharkhand – 832104. (6) Bidder shall mention the GST% of each individual line item in their technical part – I bid. . 4. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card.

b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Generic Bidders are advised to check applicable GST on their own before quoting. Buyer will not take any responsibility in this regards. GST reimbursement will be as per actuals or as per applicable rates (whichever is lower), subject to the maximum of quoted GST %. 7.
